title: fix(fields): the auto-number read display uses the theme foreground, not a fixed grey
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Fixes #35278

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：暗色模式下，自动编号字段的只读文字不再发暗，和其他字段一样清楚。
- 为什么做：它把文字颜色写死成浅色主题的灰色，汇总字段之前已按同样方式修过。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这段文字颜色不对，不影响数据，撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`@object-ui/fields` `AutoNumberField`: the read display's `text-gray-700` (no `dark:` partner) becomes `text-foreground`, the theme token `SummaryField` moved to in #34182 / PR #35269.

## Tests

- New pin `autoNumberFace.darkColour-35278.test.tsx`, same shape as the summary face's: a formatted and a bare value each read in `text-foreground` and carry no fixed `text-(gray|slate|zinc|neutral|stone)-N`. Ablation on `origin/main` `56fa31bca2`: red; with the fix: green.
- Also run with the fix: `summaryFaces.numberFace-11752` and the four fields e2e suites that render `AutoNumberField` (display-grid host channels, DOM leak, readonly host plumbing, aria-invalid registry): 6 files, all green.

Self-land: 48 added / 1 removed lines, under the area's 50-line bar.
